person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index and official Army merged file share the exact private identifier and Ignazio Cangelosi name; the Army row adds middle initial F. The identifier match is strong, while the added initial remains visible pending Box 105 review.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 105 for the employer or work setting behind the driver category, the added middle initial, and the Army-to-OSS chronology.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index gives Andrew J. Canger and a seven-digit private identifier in Box 105. The complete Army file contains one exact-name row, but its identifier does not match the printed value; the candidate is withheld rather than forced by zero-padding.
person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Review Box 105 and the original seven-digit identifier-bearing record before accepting or rejecting the exact-name Army candidate.
